cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/dev/runner.py <<'EOF'
import sys, os, time, subprocess, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
import limits
data=open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read()
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=data,
                 capture_output=True,preexec_fn=limits.apply,
                 env={'PATH':'/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin','LANG':'C','TMPDIR':'/workspace/tmp',
                      'PYTHONHASHSEED':'0','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS':'1','OMP_NUM_THREADS':'1',
                      'MKL_NUM_THREADS':'1','NETNOMOS_DEPS':'/workspace/vendor'})
print('rc',p.returncode,'wall %.2f'%(time.time()-t0),'cpu-child?')
print('stderr:',p.stderr.decode()[:1000])
print('stdout bytes',len(p.stdout))
open('/tmp/dev/out.json','wb').write(p.stdout)
EOF
